summary: Norris starts from pole but braces for a challenge from Russell's resurgent Mercedes, which dominated the sprint race and arrives Sunday with momentum and tire advantage. McLaren and Ferrari battle for track position through Zandvoort's high-speed corners, where DRS opportunities remain limited and tire management becomes the decisive weapon. A victory for Norris extends his championship lead with only six races remaining, while a Russell triumph reignites the title fight and signals Mercedes' arrival as genuine contenders.
